reviews.text: Caleb does such a great job of walking our dog multiple times a week. He is always prompt and sends pictures of her each time he walks her, always so cute!!

My name is Wally, and I'm a very sweet boy. But despite my lovable personality and handsome good looks (heads turn, what can I say), I haven't always been on my best behavior.

My human was looking for someone to walk me three mornings a week. She likes to dawdle, and let's just say... I wasn't getting much of a real walk.

Then we met Cassie and a spot opened up in her pack. After a consultation, she knew that I needed more than walks. Luckily for me, my human trusted her right away. I'm not two yet, but even I'm amazed at how much I've learned in a month.

Together we've been working on what she calls "focus" and "impulse control," and what I call "treats and a whole lot of 'yes, good boy, YES.'" I'm doing a lot more sitting, staying, leaving things, and walking nicely on a leash. I'm even working on place, crate, and bed. And no more pulling, even when other dogs and people walk by. Cassie just gets me.

She has never once missed a morning. And I would know. I wait in my crate, and the second I hear that door open, I know it's her.

And the best part? Cassie didn't just train me, she taught my human, too. My human always knows exactly what we worked on, how I did, and what to practice at home. She watches all the videos and reads all the notes Cassie sends after every session. She even taught us games we can play together at home.

If you ask me, every dog deserves a Cassie.
Wally 🐾
Absolutely the best around! They have helped turn our dog into a well trained machine!!! Thank you!!!!!

Both Cassie and Caleb are the best dog walkers I’ve ever had. They both genuinely love the dogs and it’s mutual! They are extremely reliable and have a lot of integrity. You will feel happy and safe putting your dogs in their hands.

Instantly our favorite dog walker ever 🥹 Caleb bonded so quickly with our little rescue terrier and is so flexible, reliable, and just an awesome human. On the weekends and days we don’t need a walker, we seriously can tell our dog misses him so much hahaha

We’ve recommended Critters to everyone we know and are so grateful to have found someone we trust so much. Thanks for being amazing 🫶💖

Ps we get the best photos every walk!

There's no one I trust more with my pets! I have a dog who can be a little skittish, but Caleb and Cass showed her so much patience and love that she trusted them immediately. I truly can't recommend Critters Dog Co. enough — I am able to relax when I'm away because I know how well taken care of my dog and cat are.

Caleb and Cass are the absolute best and I do not say that lightly. They are patient with my anxious dog, on time, communicative, and are consistent with all of these things. Cass and Caleb are wonderful people who run their business flawlessly and if I could give them more than 5 stars I would. If you're looking for someone to take care of your pets, I truly can't imagine two people outside of my own family that I would trust more.

Critters Dog Co is helping my overweight Beagle become the Supermodel I know she is. Lol. My beagle is under strict orders from her vet to slim down and Caleb, the owner of Critter Dog Co is helping me do that with hourlong walks three times a week.  Does my beagle look foward to her workouts? No. But the pictures I get from Caleb, her trainer tells onother story. She’s doggy smiling and her not too little hiney shimmies as she walks her way to a healthy and trim physique. She is down 5 lbs and has another 5 lbs to go. At 26 lbs my beagle will once again be a healthy and happy puppy.
Thank you, Caleb at Critter Dog Company. Even when I’m not home, you keep Presley on schedule. You come into the house and leash her up-and that’s not easy bc Presley isn’t about exercise! Together (ok just Caleb) we are gonna get Presley back to becoming the canine beauty queen she was always destined to be…
Our pup is happy and well taken care of
Responsible, trustworthy, communicative. Would highly recommend Critters Dog Co. They truly have your pup's best interests at heart.  Thank you Cassie and Caleb!

Cass and Caleb loved Millard like their own! I’m always very hesitant dropping Millard off with anyone new but they sent tons of updates, we’re super responsive, took him on lots of walks and he came back happy and tired! Can’t recommend them enough for fellow helicopter dog parents.
Caleb is the best! I trust him fully with my pups and cat. He provides video updates and regular communication.
Caleb has been great with our rescue dog! She took a little while to warm up to him but he was very patient with her and now they are great friends.

Cassie is the best! My Ollie LOVES her. She is so trustworthy and reliable; I always know she will show up on time and take fantastic care of Ollie. She also goes above and beyond just a quick visit. Couldn’t imagine surviving without her.

Caleb is incredible! My dog Bear doesn’t trust people easily and is very protective of our home, but he’s loved Caleb from the start! Caleb is trustworthy, always on time, sends puppy updates every day and is a great communicator - we just moved to LA, so I was nervous about finding the right dog walker, but we got extremely lucky to have found Critters / Caleb! Would highly recommend to anyone who needs dog care!!
Caleb has been great with my dogs!  Even my nervous lab is excited for his walks with Caleb. It’s nice to have someone I trust take care of my dogs.
Great service, flexible, and great people running it.  Highly recommended

Caleb is the nicest dog walker. Great communication. Love that he send me pics while he’s on a walk. And my dogs are always so happy to see him. He’s a savior really because with my busy schedule it’s hard to get walk ins sometimes and he 100% of the time available. Maybe we’ve been lucky but he’s always available and willing to work with you.
Caleb has been an amazing dog walker for my two dogs! He is always reliable and goes out of his way to make himself available. I can’t recommend him enough!
Caleb is the best! He is so flexible with our crazy schedule, and he loves our pup so much, I always know she's in good hands when we're away!

Consistently reliable, friendly dog walking service. Critters communication is excellent. I trust that my dog is completely safe with them. I love the photos and videos, my dog is clearly having fun :)

Caleb has been such an incredible and personable walker. We feel super lucky to have found him and his service! He’s responsive, very friendly, and clearly goes above and beyond for our dog, Wolfie, who loves his walks. We always get great photos from walks too (like the fun portrait below). I would recommend him without hesitation!

Been with Critters for two months now and my babies and I couldn’t be happier. Aaron has been walking my two greyhounds three times a week and he really treats them with as much care and love as I would. I get photos everyday and text updates along the way. Even when June had an injury, Aaron went above and beyond to help carry her down the stairs and be mindful to take her back before my other dog. I can’t recommend critters enough, truly the sweetest humans who are dog people through and through.
Our dogs love taking their walks with Caleb. He’s always on time, extremely professional, keeps them very safe, and has the greatest energy which they love! I highly recommend Critters Dog Company!

Caleb & Cassie are the absolute best. Our dog means everything to us and is appropriately pampered. We miss her when we are away and worry about her welfare. Caleb and Cassie have bonded with her as if she were their own, they communicate perfectly and effectively, and they just intuitively know what she needs. They have stayed in our home twice now in addition to walking our dog and have our complete trust. They leave the house in better shape than how they found it (and we are neat freaks) and take such good care of our dog. I can't recommend them highly enough and am so grateful to have found them!

Kathleen from Critters is the best dog walker I’ve ever had. We all want someone to love our dog the way we do, and she brings that along with punctuality, dependability and a great personality! Our little Rose loves her and we are so grateful to have her. We recommend Critters Dog Co above and beyond all others we have ever used!
Caleb is great! Our dog loves him

Kathleen has been caring our dogs and cats for over 5 years. She is responsible and reliable (and always follows up with amazing photos too!) We love her and trust her immensely. She is friendly, kind and innately understands the needs of …
Rob has been taking my Buddy out for the past few weeks and they seem to get along great!
we couldn’t be happier that we found Cassie! Our dog is so happy with her. She is a great and trustworthy housesitter, Dog sitter, dog walker! Highly recommend!.
